performanceReport.method: 10 seconds of iframe requestAnimationFrame intervals; renderer.info sampled without forcing renders. CPU/browser scheduling evidence, NOT GPU time or benchmark-comparable FPS. Background throttling and unrelated activity may affect results.

errorCapture.scope: iframe errors, unhandled rejections and console.error after listener attachment; earlier errors unavailable

wfc.scope: 1D module vocabulary; authored connected coastal volumes + marching tetrahedra surface

semanticWfc.scope: WFC role IDs drive bounded semantic shape parameters; no literal ring assembly

landform.core: six unequal hand-authored cliff planes; four profile compositions
landform.terraces: two or three role-specific substrates with oblique fading ends
landform.summit: four azimuth compositions; high crown, low crown and 2-5m saddle
landform.erosion: three nonparallel broken bedding cuts and open corner joint; sea erosion centered 6m above fixed bottom
landform.coordinates: unchanged local placement; old support-plane height and conservative footprint

layout.reference: first harness load localStorage; not independent approval evidence

rail.method: 2600 stations per lane, 3 lateral offsets, 3 heights, 2-unit tangent rays; sampled only

walkableProtection.method: Tagged pedestrian-mesh vertices and triangle centroids against conservative fixed-axis rock cylinders with 1 m lateral margin and 4 m headroom. Not continuous collision or path-connectivity proof; compare vertex hash with legacy for fixed-boundary evidence.

stacks.fieldCoordinates: rock-local XZ; height is local Y; final rock matrix converts to world
stacks.waterCoordinates: actual ocean mesh local coordinates; seat uses rendered triangle radial raycast

shoreContact.coordinates: rock-local; add returned group to rock
shoreContact.waveBinding: ocean-local radial vertex wave; shared uTime/uWaterKind; ocean-to-foam displacement matrix
shoreContact.waveLimits: static triangle ray anchors plus analytic GPU offset, not GPU raycast; ocean triangle interpolation may differ slightly
shoreContact.method: horizontal rock raycast refined by actual radial ocean raycast
shoreContact.limitations: first lateral hit only; discontinuous or hidden coast rays omitted; talus center water-supported, no physics collision
